purpose: On licensed fresh HOLDOUT text, causally split the exact L11H3 subject effective value into the current-state value branch and the layer-0 cached-value branch while holding the native subject score and every non-subject source term fixed.

licensed_precondition.rows: Licensed HOLDOUT only; FIT remains forbidden.

motivating_result.finding: The exact opposite-donor subject term p_8 u_8 recovered 0.956--1.098 of the complete-head margin effect across the four direction/template cells; the non-subject complement and its interaction were small. This motivates splitting u_8 rather than another whole-head or source-position intervention.

prior_art_audit.finding: Canonical v12 explicitly leaves the value side of p_8 u_8 as next_missing. It contains combined-effective-value swaps and downstream whole-head splits, but no current-state by cached-value factorial at L11H3/source 8.

On the same licensed HOLDOUT, swapping the complete opposite-number effective value u_8 under native p_8 improved donor margin in every cell. It did not separate the two additive branches inside u_8 and did not use a same-number value donor.

Old work globally removed the cached-value mixture or patched the layer-0 cache, affecting every downstream layer and head on one five-token template. It did not isolate L11H3/source 8 or use a held-out factorial.

Old per-layer swaps replaced the post-mixture value stream for all nine heads. L11 had a descriptive 0.312 swing fraction, but current and cached branches, head 3, and source 8 were not causally separated.

exact_decomposition.effective_value: u_8 = c + b, up to the registered finite-precision branch-sum tolerance
exact_decomposition.model_detail: The cached bus is produced once by block 0 c_v and reused by later attention blocks; it is not block 11 c_v applied to the embedding.
exact_decomposition.fixed_context: Every scientific value arm uses recipient p_8 and the recipient sum over j != 8 of p_j u_j.

conditions.opposite_both: opposite-number same-lemma current + opposite-number same-lemma cached
conditions.lexical_both: same-number different-lemma current + same-number different-lemma cached
conditions.complete_opposite_head: the complete opposite-number same-lemma L11H3 write; active task-capability control

estimands.opposite_current_main: Y(opposite current, recipient cached) - Y(recipient current, recipient cached)
estimands.opposite_cached_main: Y(recipient current, opposite cached) - Y(recipient current, recipient cached)
estimands.opposite_interaction: Y(opposite current, opposite cached) - Y(opposite current, recipient cached) - Y(recipient current, opposite cached) + Y(recipient current, recipient cached)
estimands.lexical_controls: The same three contrasts with a same-number different-lemma donor; these test whether an apparent branch effect is number-specific rather than generic lexical transfer.

outcomes.answer_directed_margin_improvement: Patched target-answer-minus-alternative-answer margin minus the identical-index native margin. The target is the opposite-number donor answer for number arms and the unchanged correct answer for lexical arms; positive is helpful in both number directions.
outcomes.target_full_vocab_CE_improvement: Identical-index native target-answer full-vocabulary CE minus patched target-answer CE; positive is helpful in both directions.
outcomes.fixed_are_minus_is_change: Patched logit(are)-logit(is) minus native logit(are)-logit(is). This signed diagnostic is reported separately and is never substituted for answer-directed task use.
outcomes.baseline: Every arm is compared with its exact index in a native batch with identical token order and batch shape.

opposing_predictions.current_branch_carries_task: In every direction/template cell, current-only improves answer-directed margin and CE on at least 3/4 rows and recovers at least 70% of the opposite-both mean margin effect.
opposing_predictions.cached_branch_carries_task: In every direction/template cell, cached-only improves answer-directed margin and CE on at least 3/4 rows and recovers at least 70% of the opposite-both mean margin effect.
opposing_predictions.interaction_is_needed: In every cell, neither single branch recovers more than 50% of the joint mean margin effect, while the positive current-by-cached interaction recovers at least 50% and is helpful in margin and CE on at least 3/4 rows.
opposing_predictions.lexical_leakage: If any same-number lexical branch contrast reaches at least 50% of the corresponding opposite-number joint margin magnitude, a number-specific interpretation is invalidated. Number specificity is supported only if every such ratio is at most 25%; intermediate values remain unresolved.

instrument_gate: Exact replay, source-term summation, branch summation, same-batch native/no-op output, installed-head algebra, complete-head task capability, and a live opposite-both value intervention must pass before interpreting branch predictions.
terminal_policy: Preserve every opposing prediction independently. Do not alter rows, pool templates, tune thresholds, or use the sign of fixed are-minus-is change as answer-directed success after outcomes.
closed_claims: syntax generality beyond the licensed templates
